name: Motor-imagery BCI EEG and behavioural assessment in prolonged disorders of consciousness
access_route: https://doi.org/10.15125/BATH-01632 (University of Bath Research Data Archive)
license: Not stated on landing page; data-use conditions prohibit redistribution - REQUIRES VERIFICATION
n_participants: 42 patients + 2 able-bodied benchmark (UWS n=14; MCS n=17; LIS n=11)
n_recordings: Multiple sessions per participant - exact count REQUIRES VERIFICATION
recording_duration: Structured MI-BCI sessions; exact duration REQUIRES VERIFICATION
event_markers: YES - task cue onset/offset and rest periods; baseline -1000 to 0 ms re cue
behavioral_exams: YES - CRS-R and WHIM linked to EEG session
verification_method: Fetched and parsed the DOI landing page
known_limitations: ACCESS IS RESTRICTED - not a download. Small n for training. Repeated sessions create dependence. A negative motor-imagery result does not establish absence of consciousness.
leakage_risks: Repeated sessions per participant - MUST split at participant level not session level
role_in_project: PRIMARY command-following dataset (Layer E). The only public-facing source of the strongest evidence tier.

name: The raw data of resting EEG of patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness
n_participants: 59 patients + 32 controls (per investigator brief - subject count REQUIRES VERIFICATION against files)
recording_duration: Sixty 2-s epochs per subject (per brief - REQUIRES VERIFICATION)
labels_available: Diagnostic category (UWS/MCS) - item-level CRS-R NOT confirmed
behavioral_exams: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - not confirmed to be item-level or contemporaneous
size_on_disk: 730.3 MB (VERIFIED via Figshare API; 298 files; BrainVision .dat/.vhdr/.vmrk)
known_limitations: Public description guarantees diagnostic category and EEG but NOT item-level CRS-R, medication timing, etiology or outcome. Epoched rather than continuous raw.
leakage_risks: Epochs from one subject must not cross folds
role_in_project: PRIMARY resting-state DoC development set. First real test of UCE v1 vs its one-feature baseline.

name: I-CARE: International Cardiac Arrest REsearch Consortium Database v2.1
n_participants: 607 public patients (per brief - REQUIRES VERIFICATION against RECORDS)
n_recordings: Continuous; up to 5 min per hour to 72 h post-ROSC
eeg_channels: 18 bipolar (per brief); channels vary by hospital and patient (VERIFIED statement)
recording_duration: Hours to several days per patient
labels_available: CPC outcome; demographics; arrest variables; temperature management; signal-quality scores
sedation_data: YES - temperature management recorded; sedation detail REQUIRES VERIFICATION
outcome_data: YES - CPC (PROGNOSTIC ONLY - never a consciousness label)
size_on_disk: 1.5 TB total uncompressed (VERIFIED - NOT the 23.7 GB stated in the brief)
verification_method: Fetched and parsed the PhysioNet landing page
known_limitations: 1.5 TB makes whole-dataset download infeasible here (19 GB free) - selective/streamed access required. CPC is prognosis not consciousness. No command-following testing.
leakage_risks: Hospital identity is a strong acquisition signature - hold out whole hospitals
role_in_project: External validation for acute coma; domain shift; confounder resistance. NEVER a consciousness-label training set.

name: TMS-EEG perturbation in patients with disorders of consciousness v1
access_status: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - EBRAINS access terms not yet checked
labels_available: Perturbational response; frontal and parietal stimulation
known_limitations: Only 12 patients. TMS artefact is severe and preprocessing choices can dominate. Too small to train on.
leakage_risks: Small n invites overfitting if used for anything but convergent validation
role_in_project: Convergent/mechanistic validation only - behaviour-independent cortical reactivity.

name: A repeated awakening study exploring the capacity of complexity measures (propofol sedation and sleep) to reflect subjective experience
license: REQUIRES VERIFICATION (OpenNeuro datasets are usually CC0)
population: Healthy adults; propofol sedation with repeated awakenings
event_markers: YES - awakening timings expected; REQUIRES VERIFICATION
size_on_disk: 83.0 GB (VERIFIED via OpenNeuro GraphQL - EXCEEDS available disk)
known_limitations: 83 GB exceeds the 19 GB free here - requires selective subject-level download. Healthy volunteers only.
leakage_risks: Repeated awakenings within subject - split at subject level
role_in_project: CRITICAL dissociation test: unresponsive WITH reported experience. Directly tests H6.

name: Data supporting Brain connectivity during propofol sedation
reference: Average reference (per brief - data supplied preprocessed)
known_limitations: Supplied PREPROCESSED (filtered, cleaned, average-referenced) - limits preprocessing-sensitivity analysis, which is a Gate A requirement. Propofol only. Healthy volunteers.
leakage_risks: Within-subject conditions - split at subject level
role_in_project: Controlled reversible perturbation; within-subject loss and recovery.

name: VitalDB intraoperative waveform and clinical database
access_status: OPEN - VERIFIED in prior project work
eeg_channels: Varies; frontal EEG/BIS channels in a subset only
labels_available: Anaesthetic agent and concentration; BIS in a subset; hemodynamics; perioperative metadata
behavioral_exams: NO - no structured consciousness examination intraoperatively
known_limitations: No behavioural consciousness testing during surgery. BIS is NOT an awareness label. EEG channels present only in a subset.
leakage_risks: Case identity; do not mix segments of one case across folds
role_in_project: Real-world anaesthesia scale and robustness; drug and age confounding.

name: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database
labels_available: Real vs imagined movement; task class
known_limitations: Healthy motor imagery does NOT demonstrate transfer to DoC patients. Method development only.
leakage_risks: Runs within subject must not cross folds
role_in_project: Motor-imagery decoder development and false-positive calibration ONLY.

name: Multimodal dataset from the CMx7-MM Experiment
labels_available: Motor imagery; passive movement; mental arithmetic; n-back; motor; combined
known_limitations: Healthy only. Modalities include eeg + beh + nirs (VERIFIED).
leakage_risks: 3 sessions per subject - split at subject level
role_in_project: Multi-paradigm intentional-modulation development; avoids over-committing to motor imagery.

name: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded
known_limitations: Sleep stages are NOT levels of consciousness. Only 2 EEG channels - cannot compute frontal/posterior UCE v1 as specified.
role_in_project: Pipeline debugging and state-transition baseline. NOTE: 2-channel montage cannot support UCE v1 regional split.

name: Sleep Heart Health Study
access_status: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - registration and data-use agreement expected
labels_available: Sleep stages; respiratory events; extensive covariates
known_limitations: Requires an approved data-use process. Sleep pathology and age are strong confounders - which is precisely why it is useful as a negative control.
role_in_project: Large-scale sleep validation; tests whether the model mainly tracks age or sleep pathology.

name: MESA Sleep
access_status: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - registration and data-use agreement expected
role_in_project: Independent demographic and medical validation; subgroup performance.
